body:
GMGUI is a lightweight and simple plugin that allows players to change their gamemode using an intuitive GUI menu.
Just use one command and switch your gamemode in seconds — no need to type long commands.

The plugin supports Minecraft 1.13+ and comes with a fully configurable config.yml.

✨ Features:

🖱️ Gamemode change via GUI

🎮 Survival / Creative / Adventure / Spectator

⚙️ Fully configurable

🚀 Lightweight and lag-free

🔌 Works on Spigot & Paper

🧾 Commands:

/gmgui – opens the gamemode GUI

🔐 Permissions:

gmgui.use – access to /gmgui

🧩 Requirements:

Spigot / Paper

Minecraft 1.13+

Java 8+

💡 Perfect for admin teams and SMP servers.
